//: Tracked in the repo, symlinked to ~/.config/swaync. NOTE: swaync parses this with json-glib, which is strict JSON - no // comments, unlike waybar's jsonc. Styling is in style.css; the palette comes from colors.css, whose symlink theme-switch.sh swaps for light/dark.
//positioning: control-center-margin-top clears the floating bar (8px margin + 34px tall) and the 12px side inset, so the panel hangs below it like Notification Center under the macOS menu bar.
//cover-screen: Default true puts a click-catcher over the whole screen, making everything behind it unreachable until dismissed. Off keeps the desktop live, as on macOS.
//theme: ignore-gtk-theme keeps swaync on its own stylesheet instead of inheriting Adwaita, which is what lets the glass palette apply cleanly in both modes.
